allowlist.name: rocksdb_transactiondb_options_set_use_per_key_point_lock_mgr
allowlist.reason: The old handwritten implementation existed in db/c.cc but was not declared in include/rocksdb/c.h. The generated declaration intentionally fixes that historical inconsistency.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_options_set_writable_file_max_buffer_size
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: the hand-written body spelled the conversion as static_cast<size_t>(v); size_t is the field's declared type, which the generated static_cast<decltype(field)>(v) names.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_compactoptions_set_bottommost_level_compaction
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: the hand-written body spelled the conversion as static_cast<BottommostLevelCompaction>(v); BottommostLevelCompaction is the field's declared type, which the generated static_cast<decltype(field)>(v) names.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_universal_compaction_options_set_stop_style
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: the hand-written body spelled the conversion as static_cast<CompactionStopStyle>(v); CompactionStopStyle is the field's declared type, which the generated static_cast<decltype(field)>(v) names.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_backup_engine_verify_backup
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: the hand-written body cast backup_id with static_cast<BackupID>; BackupID is uint32_t, the C parameter's own type, so the generated body passes it unconverted.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_column_family_handle_get_name
allowlist.reason: Equivalent result with one fewer copy: ColumnFamilyHandle::GetName() returns const std::string&, which the generated body binds by reference instead of copying into a local before CopyString.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_transaction_get_name
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: the hand-written body declared the by-value TransactionName (std::string) result as auto; the generated body names the type.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_writebatch_data
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: WriteBatch::GetDataSize() is Data().size() and std::string::data() is c_str() since C++11; the generated body reads both from the one Data() reference.

allowlist.name: rocksdb_suggest_compact_range_cf
allowlist.reason: Equivalent: the hand-written body stored the Status in a local that it only passed to SaveError(errptr, s); the generated body passes the call's result to SaveError directly.
